title: Showtime Gymnastics Academy

services.name: Classes
services.desc: Our Introduction to Tumbling class is designed to teach foundational skills from the ground up. We cover everything from basic forward and backward rolls to handstands, cartwheels, back walkovers, and front walkovers. We will also provide an introduction to back handsprings and front handsprings. This class is an excellent option for anyone looking to learn or refine their cartwheel or handstand, or to master the back walkover or front walkover. We break down each skill step-by-step, starting with the fundamentals. services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Preschool program includes gymnastics instruction, and arts and crafts. Please send your child with a healthy snack and water. Children must be potty trained. Half-day camp is all gymnastics. Coaches will teach skills for all levels and on all events. They will have a 10 min break for a snack halfway through the morning.. You can provide them with a snack, or they can purchase one from the Snack Shack or vending machines. There will be gymnastics event training from 9:00-12:00, lunch from 12:00-1:00, and gymnastics tricks and games from 1:00-4:00. Please bring a lunch, drink, and a snack for break time. services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: Looking for extra support or a confidence boost? Our private lessons give gymnasts the chance to work one-on-one, or in a smaller group with a coach on the skills that matter most to them. It’s a great way to gain confidence, fine-tune techniques, and reach new milestones. If you have a small group, consider starting your own private on demand class! Email for more info! Please send an email if you would like to schedule a private lesson or start an on demand class. Select Saturdays and Sundays- Saturday from 5:00-7:00 PM- Sunday from 1:00 - 3:00

services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Choose the party experience that best fits your child's age and group. All parties include time in the gym followed by time in our party room for celebrating. Our coaches lead the children through a structured gymnastics experience in the gym, with age-appropriate activities, games, and plenty of time to tumble, bounce, and have fun! After gym time, guests head to the party room to celebrate. Best for: Children ages 4 and up who are ready to participate in a structured, coach-led gymnastics experience.
